chapter: Auditions, musicians and the jazz club
title: Jazz Club meetings, Black performers and Mono Lee
summary: Questions about Monday meetings and Black performers at the club, and when a woman associate of Greenwood arrived.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Yeah. Did you ever go to any Monday night meetings of the New Orleans Jazz Club?
I don't know.
I thought they had meetings on Monday night or something. I don't know. And, uh... Did you ever see a black at the New Orleans Jazz Club performing?
I think I probably did, but I don't remember.
You don't remember anything?
Certainly not early on.
Yeah. I don't remember. I don't remember. I don't remember when Mono Lee came on the scene. Mono Lee.
Mono Lee.
Since B. Cray.
Oh, okay.
Yeah. What about... Do you remember when she came on the scene?
Hmm. I don't think it could have been... Before... Let's see. I wonder if it was when we were off in... In, uh... In, uh... San Francisco.
It seems right to me. It seems Greenwood was around.
Yeah.
He met her at the Tulane Library. They were both working there.
Oh.
Well, I just was trying to remember what she did with us, and if that brings any memories out.
Not a great deal.
Hmm. Peter Bocars, you saw him?
I probably did. I don't really know. Yeah.
